title: Claims Payments Computation: Reimbursing a Customer-Arranged Rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Computation.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, a customer-arranged rental is reimbursed for the claim's most recent authorization of a customer-arranged rental. That is the latest authorization on the claim whose provider is recorded as another agency outside the partner network.

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Covered days | From the rental's start date through the end date of its closing, both days included |
| Daily amount | The lower of the recorded daily rate and the option's daily limit |
| Reimbursement | The covered days multiplied by the daily amount. It is never above what the per-loss maximum still allows (the option's per-loss maximum less the agency and reimbursement payments on the claim, net of agency credits), never below zero, and rounded to the cent. |

## Worked computation (hypothetical figures, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800)

The customer rented from a local agency from August 3 through a closing end date of August 10. That is 8 covered days. The recorded rate is $64.50 and the daily limit is $60.00, so the daily amount is $60.00. 8 multiplied by $60.00 is $480.00. With $1500.00 already paid on the claim and no agency credits, the per-loss maximum still allows $300.00, so the reimbursement is $300.00. With nothing yet paid on the claim, it would be $480.00.
